In 1937, 3 players reached this threshold: Nap Lajoie (168), Tris Speaker (165), and Cy Young (153). In 1938, 4 players received 150+ votes: Pete Alexander (212), George Sisler (179), Willie Keeler (177), and Eddie Collins (175).
